1429.11: Mundavani, by the Fifth Guru (Guru Arjan Dev Ji). In the plate three things have been laid: truth, contentment and reflection. The Master's Amrit Name, the support of all, has been laid (in it) too. Whoever eats it, whoever relishes it, is saved. This thing cannot be given up; keep it enshrined in your heart, always. The dark world is crossed by clinging to (the Lord's) feet; O Nanak, all is the expanse of God. ॥1॥
Mundavani: a thing sealed, a riddle. The Third Guru's Mudavani in Sorath ki Vaar does not name the plate's three things; this Mundavani names them.
1429.12: Salok, by the Fifth Guru (Guru Arjan Dev Ji). (O God,) I have not known (the worth of) what you have done, (yet) you have made me worthy. In me, without virtue, there is no virtue; you yourself have taken pity (on me). Pity was shown, grace came, (and) I met the True Guru, my friend. If the Naam is received, I, Nanak, live, and body and mind turn green. ॥1॥
